name: GutenLab AI SEO Titles for WooCommerce
author: GutenbergLab Plugins

sections.description:
GutenLab AI SEO Titles for WooCommerce helps your WooCommerce products get discovered by AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini by automatically generating multilingual product titles and Schema.org structured data.

This plugin is independently developed and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to WooCommerce or Automattic.

Features

  • AI-powered multilingual product titles using Google Gemini API
  • Automated Schema.org structured data (Product, Offer, AggregateRating)
  • FAQ schema generation for products
  • Batch processing for multiple products at once
  • Support for 96+ languages across all regions
  • Product collections management with shortcode output
  • XML sitemap integration

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • A free Google Gemini API key (available at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)

External Services

This plugin connects to the Google Gemini API to generate AI-powered product titles and content.

  • Service: Google Gemini API (https://ai.google.dev/)
  • What data is sent: WooCommerce product title, description, categories, and attributes
  • When data is sent: Only when you click “Generate AI Preview” or run a batch job — data is never sent automatically in the background
  • Your API key: You supply your own Google Gemini API key. Requests go directly from your server to Google. No data passes through our servers.
  • Google’s Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
  • Google’s Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

No customer personal data is ever sent to any external service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce first
  2. Upload and activate this plugin
  3. Go to GutenLab AI SEO Titles > AI Settings
  4. Enter your free Google Gemini API key
  5. Go to GutenLab AI SEO Titles > Languages and select your target languages
  6. Open any WooCommerce product and click Generate AI Preview
  7. Review and save the generated multilingual titles
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, this plugin is completely free and fully functional with no locked features. A free Google Gemini API key is required to use the AI generation features.

Do I need an API key?

Yes, a free Google Gemini API key is required for AI title generation. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey — it is free to obtain.

What AI models does this plugin use?

Currently Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash). You supply your own API key directly; no data passes through our servers.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes, all WooCommerce product types are supported.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. Only product data (titles, descriptions, categories, attributes) is sent to the Google Gemini API. No customer personal data is ever transmitted.

Is this plugin affiliated with WooCommerce?

No. This plugin is an independent integration. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to WooCommerce or Automattic.
